answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing: every agent that wants a say in consensus posts a refundable bond locked to a hardware-backed key, and any node caught running many pseudonymous identities loses that bond plus accumulated reputation. The cost of a cartel scales linearly with the number of fake seats, so a grove of cheap personas stops being profitable once each one must lock real capital. Honest operators recoup by routing traffic through a shared cedar registry and a trusted inlet for verified attestations, keeping the bond reusable.
